_comment: Verifier-side annotations. questions.json stays frozen as the eval's golden set; what the VERIFIER needs in order to judge a question lives here. 'derived' = the expected value is computed by the model from tool results, so no tool will ever return it and the 'is the golden value in a tool result' rule does not apply. 'ranges' = the calendar ranges a correct run must query, for questions that name a period in words ('last week') instead of dates; TODAY is 2026-02-01, a Sunday, and a week runs Monday to Sunday (agent/config.py TODAY_NOTE).

day_wow.note: a percentage change: fetch both weeks, then divide

calc_share.note: a share: one category's revenue divided by the total

calc_top_two.note: the sum of the top two categories: add two rows of one result
